subject: Order form: pricing cadence, invoice routing & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Ops <procure@acme-corp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Order form pricing cadence and invoicing routing

Hi Maria / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion I'm attaching v3 of the order form with the suggested pricing bands and minimum commit ladder. Two quick clarifications before we proceed to legal:

- Invoice recipient: you mentioned APAC finance will pay for the first tranche but countersigned PO should be routed to Acme US (invoices@acme-corp.com). Can you confirm that both entities can accept separate invoices?
- VAT handling: Acme said you would provide a VAT certificate for the UK/EU work scope. If you can share that we will remove the EU reverse charge language on our side.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm invoice recipient(s) and whether PO number will appear on invoices.
2) Acme legal to review the order form appendix we flagged under Section 2 (pricing cadence).
3) If OK, we'll route to DocuSign (I can prep).

Attaching: OrderForm_v3.pdf (redlined for pricing bands).

-K
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(j) 415-555-0180

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Order form pricing cadence and invoicing routing

Thanks Jordan — adding a couple of notes from Legal/Finance side. Maria, quick answers inline: 

- Invoice routing: we can invoice a United States entity (Redwood Inc. / Redwood Inference) to Acme US. If Acme needs invoices split across entities we will need the exact remit-to details and a primary PO per invoice sequence. Treasury requires a stable remit-to for ACH/wire setup.
- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net 30 for self-serve; for committed capacity we can consider Net 45 with a finance approval (Ben looping). If Acme needs Net 60 we will need to put that through contracts for a credit review.
- VAT evidence: Please share VAT_Certificate_Acme.pdf as Ben requested. If the certificate covers the jurisdictions listed, we will accept reverse charge and not gross up invoices.

Ben — can you confirm whether Net 45 is approvable for this deal size (ACME-2026-019) or do we need a credit holdback?

Maria — can Acme Legal send any required redlines to section 4 (taxes) and section 7 (invoicing cadence)? Laura will own the redline intake for the order form.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Order form pricing cadence and invoicing routing

Kimberly / Maria — quick finance note:

- Net 45: Approveable with deal manager sign-off and AR notification. For ACME-2026-019 I'd be comfortable approving Net 45 if we (a) have the VAT certificate where applicable, and (b) a primary PO is supplied for the first two tranches.
- Minimum commit phasing: Recommend we invoice the activation fee at signature (100%), then tranche invoices on 30/60/90 day cadence tied to usage bands. 
- Tax gross-up: If Acme cannot supply the VAT certificate covering the EU/UK, Redwood will invoice gross and we will need to pass through VAT.

Attachment: VAT_Certificate_Acme.pdf (please confirm receipt).

If Acme confirms remit-to and provides PO numbers, we can finalize the order form and send to Laura for redline capture.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Maria Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme-corp.com>, Acme Finance <invoices@acme-corp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Order form pricing cadence and invoicing routing

Kimberly / team — thanks. Quick confirmations from Acme: 

- Remit-to / invoice routing: Acme can accept split invoices. Primary remit-to for the program will be Acme US (invoices@acme-corp.com). For regional tranches that require EU legal entity, we will follow up with remit details this week.
- PO numbers: We will issue PO-ACME-9812 for the activation + first tranche and will include PO on the invoice PDF.
- VAT certificate: Attached VAT_Certificate_Acme.pdf — covers UK and DE for the period requested. We plan to follow up with the EU entity remit for tranches > $250k.

Regarding redlines: Acme Legal has a few comments on Section 2 (pricing cadence) and Section 4 (taxes). We prefer: (i) explicit callout that Redwood will provide a consolidated monthly invoice per remit-to where possible, and (ii) a clause that any withholding taxes will be handled per local law with supporting evidence to be exchanged. Laura — please confirm how you want our redlines submitted (Doc with compare or DocuSign annotated?).

We are happy to proceed with Net 45. Please send final redline capture and the DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Maria Gomez
Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procure@acme-corp.com

Attachments: VAT_Certificate_Acme.pdf, Redlines_annotated.docx
